title: 3x3 Eyes
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Yakumo, a young man in Tokyo, meets Pai, the last of the three-eyed immortal Sanjiyan, who wants to become human. To save his life she absorbs his soul, making him immortal and bound to her, and the two travel in search of a way to make her human while fighting demons and monsters. Pai has a second, fierce personality.
life_message: A good life means loyal love and the courage to protect someone, while seeking to be fully human rather than an immortal power.
